title: Assignment 19 · Public policy
summary: Public policy. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Blossom Farm Products Co. v. Kasson Cheese Co., Inc.: A lawful sale of an ingredient became unenforceable when the seller knowingly facilitated the buyer’s continuing scheme to mislabel imitation cheese as real cheese.

X.L.O. Concrete Corp. v. Rivergate Corp.: A contract connected with an antitrust conspiracy was not automatically unenforceable; the court required a developed record on whether payment would enforce the prohibited arrangement itself.

Hassler v. Circle C Resources: The Wyoming Supreme Court abandoned judicial rewriting of unreasonable noncompetes and directed judgment for the employee because this covenant’s duration and geographical reach were unreasonable.

Additional assigned materials: FTC removal of Non-Compete Rule.
